subject: ela
intro: Pick the point, reason, or evidence.

items.prompt:
Read.

Our school should recycle. Recycling saves trees.

The author's main point is:
A) Our school should recycle
B) Trees are tall
C) Trash is heavy

A fact or example that backs up a point is called:
A) evidence
B) a title
C) a guess

steps: Supports the point. Key is A.

items.prompt:
A statement that tells WHY is a:
A) reason
B) picture
C) heading

Read.

Kids should sleep more. Studies show rested kids learn better and get sick less.

Which is EVIDENCE?
A) Kids should sleep more
B) Studies show rested kids learn better
C) Sleep is nice
items.answer: B) Studies show rested kids learn better

steps: A fact from studies. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) Studies show rested kids learn better

items.prompt:
Read.

We need more parks because they give kids a safe place to play.

The REASON is:
A) We need more parks
B) They give kids a safe place to play
C) Parks have grass
items.answer: B) They give kids a safe place to play

solution.answer: B) They give kids a safe place to play

items.prompt:
Which gives the STRONGEST support for a point?
A) a fact from a study
B) 'because I said so'
C) a joke
items.answer: A) a fact from a study

steps: Facts are strong evidence. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) a fact from a study

items.prompt:
Read.

Cities should add bike lanes. In one city, bike lanes cut car crashes by 30%. Biking is also healthy.

Which sentence is EVIDENCE (data), not just a reason?
A) Cities should add bike lanes
B) Bike lanes cut car crashes by 30%
C) Biking is healthy
items.answer: B) Bike lanes cut car crashes by 30%

steps: A statistic = evidence. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) Bike lanes cut car crashes by 30%

items.prompt:
Why do authors include reasons AND evidence for a point?
A) To make the argument convincing and supported
B) To make it longer only
C) To hide the point
items.answer: A) To make the argument convincing and supported

steps: Support strengthens arguments. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) To make the argument convincing and supported
